title: Core constant-realization derived scalar comparison
statement: For a scheme X, commutative rings B and C in universe t, a ring map q : B → C, and a cochain complex P of B-modules, the completed derived change along adicConstantMap(X,q) applied to the finite constant model of P is isomorphic to the finite constant model of the ordinary scalar extension of P along q. The two Koszul constant functors are assumed to preserve zero morphisms.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 0G7E; constant realization and derived scalar extension

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: derived extension cannot be replaced by ordinary termwise extension on an arbitrary non-K-flat complex. For Z→Z/2 and P=(Z/2)[0], derived tensor has a nonzero Tor_1 term while ordinary tensor does not. This false intermediate has been withdrawn. Its parent lem-weil-pbc-finite-model-derived-scalar-comparison is proved directly from the generic derived constant-realization comparison and a coefficient-lift-compatible K-flat resolution, without this assertion.
